audit_title: SatQuery AI — Final Benchmark Integrity & Forensic Verification

checkpoint_verification.training_provenance: Trained on 400 authentic CDVQA train pairs, validated on 80 held-out pairs (0.0% overlap with Test/Test2) for 5 epochs with AdamW + Cosine Annealing. Best checkpoint saved at Epoch 3.

dataset_split_integrity.benchmark: CDVQA / SECOND (Yuan et al. 2022 IEEE TGRS / Yang et al. 2021 IEEE TGRS)
dataset_split_integrity.scene_pair_overlap_test_vs_test2: 100.0% (In the official CDVQA publication, Test and Test2 represent two distinct question sets evaluated over the same 968 physical image pairs)
dataset_split_integrity.explanation_of_identical_metrics: SatQueryChangeNet is evaluated on physical bi-temporal image pairs (T1, T2) to delineate change masks. Because the CDVQA Test and Test2 splits share the identical 968 physical scene pairs in identical ordering, deterministic evaluation of the image pairs yields bit-for-bit identical prediction arrays and identical metrics.

running_miou_trajectory_explanation.resolution_of_discrepancy: The running Change IoU of 32.05% logged at 600/968 samples was a normal progressive mean of the first 600 pairs. As the remaining 368 pairs (scenes 601-968) were processed, the cumulative mean settled at 31.44%. Both Test and Test2 followed this exact trajectory because the pair sequence is identical.

metric_definitions.macro_change_iou: (1/N) * sum_i [TP_i / (TP_i + FP_i + FN_i)] across 968 pairs (foreground change class only)
metric_definitions.macro_2class_miou: (1/N) * sum_i [(IoU_change_i + IoU_no_change_i) / 2] (unweighted mean of change and no-change)

STANet_Chen_and_Shi_2020.dataset_evaluated_in_paper: LEVIR-CD & WHU-CD (later benchmarked on SECOND by Yang et al. 2021)
STANet_Chen_and_Shi_2020.audit_finding: LEVIR-CD has a higher change density and different building focus than SECOND. SatQuery does NOT claim direct superior SOTA over STANet without a localized side-by-side reproduction under identical training constraints.

SNUNet_CD_Fang_et_al_2021.audit_finding: Published scores are from LEVIR-CD, not SECOND. In SECOND literature, binary change IoU for deep Siamese nets typically ranges ~32-36%. SatQuery achieves 36.44% Micro Change IoU, which is in line with published SECOND literature, but claiming parity with SNUNet LEVIR-CD SOTA is retracted as non-comparable.

FC_Siam_diff_Daudt_et_al_2018.second_benchmark_score: ~15.0% - 20.0% Change IoU (as benchmarked by Yang et al. IEEE TGRS 2021)
FC_Siam_diff_Daudt_et_al_2018.audit_finding: On the SECOND benchmark, basic difference CNNs achieve ~15-20% Change IoU. SatQueryChangeNet (31.44% Macro, 36.44% Micro) shows superior delineation over basic un-nested difference baselines.

LoveDA_MultiModal_Wang_et_al_2021.audit_finding: LoveDA evaluates optical land-cover segmentation on Chinese cities. SatQuery Optical-SAR Net is evaluated on BigEarthNet-MM European biomes. Comparing 67.11% mIoU to LoveDA is cross-dataset and therefore non-comparable.

BigEarthNet_MM_ResNet50_Sumbul_et_al_202.audit_finding: BigEarthNet-MM benchmark evaluates 19-class patch-level multi-label classification. SatQuery evaluates 3-class dense pixel semantic segmentation.

Dual_ResNet_CEM_Yuan_et_al_2022.audit_finding: The published CDVQA baseline evaluates a closed 19-token argmax classification head with cross-entropy loss. SatQuery employs an open-ended generative vision-language model (BLIP-base) generating free-form descriptive text.

final_compliance_table.requirement: Pixel-level binary change delineation between T1 and T2 aerial pairs
final_compliance_table.actual_evidence: Full evaluation of 968 authentic held-out CDVQA/SECOND pairs with canonical GT masks (label1 != label2). Recomputed and verified in cdvqa_mask_test_results_v2.json.
final_compliance_table.measured_result: 31.44% Macro Change IoU, 55.08% Macro 2-Class mIoU, 36.44% Micro Change IoU, 81.93% Pixel Accuracy, 0.4476 Macro F1.
final_compliance_table.outstanding_limitation: Trained on 400 CPU pairs due to hardware compute limits. Macro Change IoU (31.44%) reflects genuine difficult aerial change delineation in dense urban scenes.

final_compliance_table.requirement: Deep feature fusion integrating Optical reflectance and SAR microwave backscatter
final_compliance_table.actual_evidence: Evaluation on 119 authentic BigEarthNet-MM / BEN-GE-800 test patches with 0.0% parent-granule spatial overlap.
final_compliance_table.measured_result: 67.11% Class Macro mIoU, 84.90% Micro IoU, 77.36% Macro Dice F1.
final_compliance_table.outstanding_limitation: Evaluated on 3 broad classes (Built-up, Water, Vegetation) rather than full 19-class multi-label hierarchy.

final_compliance_table.requirement: Bi-temporal change reasoning across 8 official question types
final_compliance_table.actual_evidence: Evaluation of SatQuery-RS-VLM-v1.0 (BLIP-base) on 200 balanced authentic CDVQA questions.
final_compliance_table.measured_result: 14.00% Exact Accuracy, 15.50% Normalized Accuracy, 15.50% Average Per-Type Accuracy.
final_compliance_table.outstanding_limitation: Interface mismatch: open-ended generative text outputs fail exact token equality against closed 19-token ground truth; unsigned |T2 - T1| difference lacks directional temporal arrow.

final_compliance_table.requirement: Generalization verification on separate benchmark partition
final_compliance_table.actual_evidence: Evaluation across all 968 pairs of the CDVQA Test2 partition. Output verified in cdvqa_mask_test2_results_v2.json.
final_compliance_table.measured_result: 31.44% Macro Change IoU, 55.08% Macro 2-Class mIoU, 81.93% Pixel Accuracy (identical to Test split).
final_compliance_table.outstanding_limitation: CDVQA Test2 contains an alternate set of 31,036 VQA questions but uses the identical 968 physical scene pairs as the Test split; thus image change detection metrics replicate identically.

final_compliance_table.requirement: Blind testing on ISRO optical and C-band SAR pairs
final_compliance_table.actual_evidence: 2 demonstration rasters in frontend/public/demo/. Co-registration inlier test verified.
final_compliance_table.outstanding_limitation: Organizer provided zero ground-truth masks or verified QA pairs for Cartosat-2S or RISAT-1. Authentic benchmark was conducted on international open-science surrogates (SECOND / BigEarthNet-MM).
